name: dsh-authorize-app

one_liner.zh: 在 DSH 网页设置中提供连接应用区和扩展卡片槽位。
one_liner.en: Adds a Connected Apps settings section and extension card slot to the DSH web client.

readme_mismatch: README describes an empty app list and placeholder host tool; client code includes Gmail and Notion cards, and the host registers installed-app and install routes.
README states no host-side registry or transport; current client uses host HTTP routes for installed status and package installation.

completeness.reason: Core settings slot and host routes exist, while the client only presents two fixed app cards and the tool remains an example.

code.reason: Host routes and client slot registration are separated and typed, with method and package checks plus basic error responses.

docs.reason: README documents installation, slot integration, and architecture with a minimal card example.

maintenance.reason: The listed repository has two commits and its recorded push date is 2026-08-15.

tests.reason: The extracted repository facts report zero test files and no CI workflow.

quality.notes: Source review is limited to the lite route.
